answer: Attention-Duration Ledger. Every identity must post a rolling sonnet of solved micro-tasks, each requiring minutes of sequential focus that cannot be parallelized across clones. Rewards release only after a continuous session; a fresh sockpuppet starts at zero and must replay the full duration, so farming N identities costs N times the wall-clock attention, not just N registrations. Idle gaps above a threshold reset the ledger, mirroring how an island erodes under constant surf. Coordination is cheap; sustained focus is the karst that resists it.
